detail_record:
REQ-TIED_CONTEXT_ADAPTIVE_ENGINEERING:
  category: Functional
  description: Optional opt-in practice contracts, context profiles, deterministic selection, reassessment, and method-effectiveness readout around existing TIED controls.
  name: Context-adaptive practice layer (CASE v1)
  priority: P1
  rationale:
    benefits:
      - Rule-selected practice overlay without replacing TIED checklist authority.
      - Deterministic selection receipts for methodology learning pilots.
    problems_solved:
      - CASE research not executable in MCP.
      - No versioned practice library bound to TIED PROC/tools.
    why: Adopt evidence-backed CASE subset per working plan; EASAR dogfood path.
  related_requirements:
    depends_on:
      - REQ-TIED_EASAR_RECOVERY
      - REQ-QUALITY_ASSURANCE_EVIDENCE
      - REQ-METHODOLOGY-LEARNING-EXPERIMENT
      - REQ-METHODOLOGY-CONFORMANCE-EFFECTIVENESS-PAIRING
      - REQ-REQUEST_EVIDENCE_ENVELOPE
      - REQ-TIED_ADVERSARIAL_INQUIRY
      - REQ-MODULE_VALIDATION
    related_to: []
    supersedes: []
  satisfaction_criteria:
    - criterion: SC-CAE-CONTRACTS — practice-contract.v1 library validated.
    - criterion: SC-CAE-PROFILE — UNKNOWN criticality never treated as LOW.
    - criterion: SC-CAE-SELECT — deterministic selection-receipt.v1.
    - criterion: SC-CAE-REASSESS — immutable snapshots and explicit loop-back actions.
    - criterion: SC-CAE-MCP — read-only context_adaptive MCP tools.
    - criterion: SC-CAE-DOGFOOD — EASAR baseline vs rule-selected pilot without causal claim.
    - criterion: SC-CAE-REGRESS — existing gate/EASAR/envelope suites remain green.
  status: In Progress
  traceability:
    architecture:
      - ARCH-TIED_CONTEXT_ADAPTIVE_ENGINEERING
    implementation:
      - IMPL-TIED_CONTEXT_ADAPTIVE_CONTRACTS
      - IMPL-TIED_CONTEXT_ADAPTIVE_PROFILE
      - IMPL-TIED_CONTEXT_ADAPTIVE_SELECTOR
      - IMPL-TIED_CONTEXT_ADAPTIVE_REASSESS
      - IMPL-TIED_CONTEXT_ADAPTIVE_EVAL_LINK
    tests:
      - mcp-server/src/context-adaptive/*.test.ts
